name: grok-bridge
description: Unofficial community bridge between Grok Bots and Cursor agents: chat with Cursor SDK agents in a Cursor-style panel, and let Grok Bots drive them over MCP.

grokBridge.nodePath.description: Path to a Node.js >= 22.13 binary used to run the SDK helper. Empty = auto-detect (PATH, nvm, fnm, volta, Homebrew).

grokBridge.sdkDir.description: Optional override: a folder whose node_modules contains @cursor/sdk. Empty = the SDK Grok Bridge installs into its global storage on first use.

grokBridge.cwd.description: Optional override for the agents' working directory. Empty = first workspace folder.

grokBridge.defaultModel.description: Model id used for new prompts.

grokBridge.mcpEnabled.description: Run the local MCP server so Grok Bots can drive Cursor agents (http://127.0.0.1:<mcpPort>/mcp, bearer token).

grokBridge.mcpPort.description: Port of the local MCP server. It binds to 127.0.0.1 only.

grokBridge.allowedRoots.description: Extra folders (besides the open workspace folders) that MCP clients may run agents in. Subfolders are included; symlinks are resolved.

grokBridge.mcpMaxRuns.description: Maximum number of agent runs MCP clients can have in flight at once.

grokBridge.mcpWriteConfigFile.description: Also write the MCP config, including the token, to <globalStorage>/mcp.json (mode 600) so local scripts can read it. Off by default.
